questions.question: Where did the Egyptian civilization develop?
questions.answer: Along the Nile River in northeastern Africa.

questions.question: The Nile River was important to the Egyptian civilization.
Who was the ruler of ancient Egypt?
Fill in the blank: The Egyptians built large ______ as tombs for their pharaohs.
What was the main river of ancient Egypt?
Observe the image and identify the monument.
Which image shows an Egyptian pharaoh?
The Nile River provided fertile land for farming.
Fill in the blank: Egyptians wrote using ______.
What material did the Egyptians use to make paper?
What was the purpose of the pyramids?
questions.answer: They were built as tombs for pharaohs.

questions.question: Ancient Egyptians believed in life after death.
Observe the image and identify the writing system.
Which image shows the Nile River?
Explain why the Nile River was called the 'Gift of Egypt.'
questions.answer: Because it provided water, fertile soil, transportation, and supported agriculture.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The preserved dead bodies of ancient Egyptians are called ______.
Mummification helped preserve bodies after death.
Which structure is one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World?
Why did the Egyptians develop irrigation systems?
questions.answer: To use the Nile River's water for farming.

questions.question: Explain three important achievements of the Egyptian civilization.
questions.answer: The Egyptians built pyramids, developed hieroglyphic writing, and made advances in agriculture, medicine, and architecture.
